blurb: Fisher information rate from the full 2D two-sphere BVP, capturing both sides of the capillary-bridging bifurcation.  Sweeps phi_inf (alphas, as a fraction of the dilute binodal) at fixed (omega_b, R, chi_b=2.5); for each phi_inf solves the unbridged (inward) and bridged (outward, dense-seeded) branches on a d-grid, takes the equilibrium U_full(d)=min(F)-F_ref and Phi_surf(d) on that branch, and integrates the polymer P_eq(d) to get phi_probe.
